source_jd_requirement_summary.text: We are looking for a Junior AI and Full-Stack Software Engineer to build user-facing software applications, AI-assisted workflows, and secure data-driven features
Build and improve AI-assisted web applications using Python and Streamlit
Create multi-step LLM pipelines for document parsing, information extraction, keyword matching, structured analysis, and summary generation
Integrate the OpenAI API or LiteLLM and use prompt engineering to produce reliable application outputs
Implement retrieval-augmented generation workflows using ChromaDB to retrieve, compare, and analyse stored documents
Develop persistent saved sessions, reports, chat history, and CRUD workflows using SQLite
Build frontend and full-stack application features using React and JavaScript or TypeScript
Integrate React applications with Supabase and PostgreSQL through PostgREST
Implement authentication workflows, Row-Level Security policies, and secure database access
Parse PDF and DOCX documents using Python document-processing libraries
Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborate effectively in a small software team
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or a related technical discipline
Project, internship, or academic experience developing Python applications
Hands-on experience with Python
Hands-on experience with Streamlit
Experience building AI applications or LLM-powered software workflows
Experience integrating the OpenAI API or LiteLLM
Experience implementing retrieval-augmented generation using ChromaDB
Experience with SQLite or PostgreSQL database design
Experience implementing authentication workflows or database access control
Experience parsing PDF or DOCX documents
Experience building user-facing application features in a small development team
Experience with Android Studio, Kotlin, or Jetpack Compose
Experience developing mobile application interfaces
Experience with Unity and C# gameplay scripting
Experience with C++ custom game engines
Experience with asset management, systems programming, or FMOD audio integration
Experience taking a software project from initial setup to a working user-facing application
